determinism: Fixed viewports only: desktop 1280x800 and compact 390x844, set before navigation.
Animations and caret are disabled through Playwright's toHaveScreenshot options.
The test server clock is frozen (2026-07-21T12:00:00.000Z), so every rendered timestamp is a fixture constant.
All projection data comes from committed fixture files and in-test constants — no live task source, journal, or network data.

Font rendering uses the local system stack (Inter falls back to ui-sans-serif); baselines are captured and compared on the platform recorded in baselinePlatform and are not portable across OS font rasterizers.
QUIRKS_STATE_DIR is pointed at a throwaway temp directory so sync-outbox state never leaks between runs.

acceptedDivergences.summary: v3 draws the preflight identity block inside a dark topbar; the shipped UI renders it in the light WorkspaceHeader under the shared five-view nav shell. The governed hierarchy (identity first, safety second, metrics third) is preserved; only the surface diverges. The v3 runner-health badges require data no projection provides and are not rendered.
The mocks hide the nav below 900px as a mock shortcut; the shipped shell keeps navigation visible with a wrapping row. The implementation deliberately exceeds the reference here.

v4/v5 show a 'Runner health' nav item and v4 a 'New campaign' primary; the founding spec fixes five views and no server capability backs either, so the shipped nav is Existing tasks / Campaigns only, with Task history breadcrumb-only per v5's crumb.

v3's 'Edit routing' / 'Use current agent only' buttons, v3's tab row, and v4's selection checkboxes + 'Build campaign proposal' footer require server capabilities that do not exist; rendering them would ship dead controls, so they are deliberately absent.
v3's map task cards repeat task titles; the shipped map renders id/owner/score only and defers titles to the complete task list, keeping one title authority for strict locators and honest density.

v4's fifth campaign stat is '30-DAY SPEND'; the summary projection has no aggregate spend window, so the shipped fifth stat is 'Recorded' (campaigns in scope). Recorded spend renders in the inspector only when the projection carries it — spend is never invented.
v3 uses --ink:#172033 while v4/v5 use #182230; the plan resolves the drift to #182230, so v3 comparisons tolerate this one-step difference.

v5 shows six header stats including duration, usage dollars, and landed commit; the shipped projection carries none of those facts, so the header renders four projection-backed stats (iterations, artifact refs, availability, latest outcome) instead of inventing evidence.
